title: The KARNATAKA PROFESSIONAL EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION OF ADMISSION AND FIXATION OF FEE) (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, 2014
full_text: The KARNATAKA PROFESSIONAL EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION OF ADMISSION AND FIXATION OF FEE) (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, 2014 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 29 Enactment Date: 2014-08-28 Act Year: 2014 Short Title: The KARNATAKA PROFESSIONAL EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION OF ADMISSION AND FIXATION OF FEE) (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, 2014 Long Title: An Act to provide for recognition of the consensual arrangement or agreement entered into between the State Government and the Private Unaided Educational Institutions imparting Professional Educational Courses and for other matters, as provided in the judgment of the Supreme Court of India in P.A.
